id.description:
A decimal **string**: the id is a `u64` counter, and a bare JSON
number past 2^53−1 silently rounds in common consumers.
`--attachment` accepts the same spelling.

input_owner.description:
Unconditional, unlike the optionals elsewhere: an omitted key
would read as "this daemon does not report it".

AttrRunJson.description: One pen applied to `len` consecutive columns.

len.description: Columns covered; `0` covers nothing and is not a run.

link.description:
1-based handle into the hyperlink registry `GridMsg::Hyperlink`
populates; `null` for an unlinked run.

AttributesJson.description:
One pen. `flags` is a bitmap, bit 0 bold through bit 10
ISO-protected (`docs/reference/row-codec.md` "Attribute runs").

underline_style.description: Meaningful only while the underline flag is set.

row.description:
The region's own coordinate space: scrollback negative, live
rows their grid index, mark ranges from `0`.

ClientHello.description:
The first message a client sends. Its shape is the same in every
version, so a writer can read it before any version is agreed.

versions.description: The versions the client reads, in any order.

ClientMessage.description: Everything a client sends after the handshake.

oneOf.description: Input for the attach stream `id` names.
Ends the stream `id` names; its terminal still follows.

selection.description:
Bit 0 is the clipboard, bit 1 X11 PRIMARY
(`felis.proto` `GridClipboardSet.selection`).

ColSpanJson.description: One highlight segment, on one row.

oneOf.description: The renderer's configured default for this channel.
xterm-256 palette slot.

EnvBytesJson.description: One entry of a child's base environment, as raw platform bytes.

ErrorKind.description: Why a request or a stream failed. A new token is a new version.

oneOf.description: The message was malformed or named something it cannot.
The session ended first.
A cap was reached: sessions, streams, connections.
The daemon is too old for the request.
The daemon refused on the merits; `message` says why.
Another client took the session away.

Another client switched the window: to the error's `session`
on this daemon, or to another daemon when it names none.
The connection to the daemon ended.

session.description:
For `moved`, the session on this daemon the window was
switched to.

oneOf.description: Never written to; renders as a blank.
7-bit printable ASCII.

1-based handle into the cluster registry `GridMsg::Cluster`
populates.
Right half of a double-wide glyph in the previous column.
Continuation column of an OSC 66 sized run.

requested.description: Absent from a daemon that does not report the request.

serial.description:
Creation order among the image's placements; absent from a
daemon that does not report it.

ImageTargetJson.description: What an [`ImageJson::Header`] opens a transfer for.

serial.description: Creation order; absent from a daemon that does not report it.

oneOf.description: Kitty's 1-based frame numbering; `0` is not a frame.

anchor.description:
The anchor of the browsing `viewport_state` this offset
was computed from; absent reads it against the current
bottom.

Item.description: One stream item, tagged by what it is.

oneOf.description: An attach stream's first item, whether it attached or created.

minor.description: The daemon wire minor this stream speaks.

oneOf.description: A wait's steps were all written; carries the full id.
The `OSC 133 ; D` a wait waited for.

KeyJson.description: The logical key a keystroke resolved to.

oneOf.description: A dead key or a bare modifier: no encoding of its own.

mods.description: Bits 0–2: shift, alt, ctrl. xterm has no Super bit.

px.description: Pixel column in the text area, 1-based.

py.description: Pixel row in the text area, 1-based.

oneOf.description: Function-key index, `1..=35`.

NotificationJson.description: One desktop notification a session fired.

attached.description: A window is attached and flashed its own attention.

OpResult.description: A successful point reply, tagged with the operation it answers.

Open.description: What a stream carries until its terminal.

oneOf.description:
Items: one [`Item::Attached`], then [`Item::Grid`] and
[`Item::Image`]. The client sends input on its id.
An existing session.
A session spawned for this stream, which the daemon removes again if the stream cannot start.

[`Request::Send`] that then waits for the session's next
`OSC 133 ; D`. Items: one [`Item::Sent`], then one
[`Item::Mark`]. Empty `steps` only wait.
Items: [`Item::Match`], newest line first.

query.description: A literal substring, or a pattern when `regex` is set.

oneOf.description:
Items: [`Item::Row`], oldest first; the terminal carries the
region's exit code.

ansi.description: Also carry each row's SGR reconstruction.

max_rows.description: Only the youngest rows, still oldest first.

oneOf.description:
Items: [`Item::Notification`], with [`ServerMessage::Lag`]
where events were skipped.

PaletteActionJson.description: What a [`GridJson::PaletteColor`] does to its slot.

ProgramStatusObject.description:
One OSC 7501 record, every value as the program sent it. `state` and
`kind` are open vocabularies: a value this build does not list is a
newer one, not an error.

oneOf.description: The most recent `OSC 133 C → D` range.
The most recent `OSC 133 B → D` range.
Answered by [`OpResult::List`].
Answered by [`OpResult::Info`].

Spawns a session nobody attaches to; answered by
[`OpResult::Create`].
Answered by [`OpResult::Kill`].
Answered by [`OpResult::Tag`].

Writes every step in order, or none when any is refused;
answered by [`OpResult::Send`] once the session took the last.

RequestedDimsJson.description: Geometry a client asks for, before the daemon admits it.

RequestedExtentJson.description: The `c=` / `r=` a put asked for; `0` is automatic.

RgbJson.description: A 24-bit color, as an object rather than the domain tuple.

RowCellsJson.description:
A row's cells. One encoding today: attribute runs over a flat
grapheme list, which is what the packed row stores.

attr_runs.description: Consecutive runs covering every grapheme exactly once.

graphemes.description: One entry per column, left to right.

soft_wrap_continued.description: The row continues into the next one without a newline.

RowJson.description:
One dirty row of a [`GridJson::RowDelta`]. The cells ride the
row codec's structural form (`docs/reference/row-codec.md`),
never the packed bytes the socket carries.

SearchMatchJson.description: One logical line holding a hit.

anchor.description:
The history point `line_index` and the segments' rows count
from, which keeps a scrollback hit valid while output
advances; absent from a daemon that does not report it.

col_spans.description: One per touched row, so not 1:1 with `byte_spans`.

line_index.description:
The line's topmost row: scrollback negative (`-1` the
youngest), live rows their grid index.

oneOf.description: Scrollback plus the live primary screen.
The live grid alone.

SendStepJson.description:
One input step of a send, as a window's paste, raw bytes,
keystroke or mouse event would carry it.

ServerHello.description:
The writer's answer to [`ClientHello`], shaped alike in every
version.

oneOf.description: Every later message is spelled as `version` names.
No offered version is one this writer speaks; nothing follows.

ServerMessage.description:
Everything a writer sends after the handshake. A request ends
with exactly one `reply` or `error`; a stream with exactly one
`end`, `error` or `lagged`, after its items.

oneOf.description:
Not a terminal: `dropped` items were skipped and the stream
goes on.
The stream finished.

exit_code.description: A capture region's closing `OSC 133 ; D` code.

oneOf.description: The request or the stream failed.
The stream was cut off because its consumer fell behind.

exit_code.description:
`send --wait`'s observed mark code. Absent for a bare
`OSC 133 ; D`, and on the verbs that never wait.

SessionRow.description:
A session row: the object `felis sessions info --format json`
prints, plus the creation order a tab bar sorts on.

attachments.description:
Always present, like `tags`: a picker's `.attachments[]` must be
iterable on a parked session too.

program_status.description: OSC 7501 records, sorted by id. Always present, like `tags`.

spawn_cwd.description:
The directory the child was started in; unlike `cwd`, it never
follows the program.

tags.description:
Always present, empty for an untagged session, so a `jq` picker
can rely on `.tags` being iterable.

terminal_progress.description:
The last `OSC 9 ; 4` progress the program reported and has not
cleared.

SizedCellJson.description: The sizing that applies to one column of this row.

cell_width.description: `w`, 0..=7; `0` derives the width from the text.

frac_num.description: `n`, 0..=15 and below `frac_den` whenever that is non-zero.

SourceRectJson.description: Sub-region of an image, in image pixels.

SpawnArgsJson.description: Every key may be absent, which reads as its default.

dims.description: `null` asks for the daemon default geometry.

tags.description: Sorted by the daemon and always present, matching `list` / `info`.

TerminalProgressObject.description:
One `OSC 9 ; 4` report. `state` is an open vocabulary, as
[`ProgramStatusObject::state`] is.

ThemeActionJson.description: What a [`GridJson::ThemeColor`] does to its channel.

ViewportAnchorJson.description:
Opaque history point of a browsing viewport offset; a client
echoes it back unchanged.

description: One message of the felis JSON protocol, in either direction. A reader selects its branch on `type`, and ignores any property this document does not name: within a version a writer may add an optional field.
